list.title: Verify Before You Distill: Prompt-Level Teacher Gating for On-Policy Distillation

extra.desc: Teacher-Gated On-Policy Distillation verifies teacher reliability per prompt via verifier-scored probes, routing to dense distillation or verifier-grounded reinforcement learning to improve training efficiency and accuracy.

list.title: Real-World Knowledge-Guided Change Data Synthesis for Remote Sensing

extra.desc: KnowChange uses vision-language models to guide flexible, diverse change data synthesis for improving change detection training.

list.title: Unfold The World: Factorize 4D Properties in Reinforcing Spatial Reasoning

extra.desc: FactoSR improves vision-language model spatial reasoning by decomposing 3D and temporal recovery into factorized geometric sub-objectives optimized via reinforcement learning.

list.title: HarvestBench: Measuring Whether LLM Agents Will Pay to Avoid Killing Animals

extra.desc: HarvestBench evaluates LLM agents in a farm simulation where they choose between harming animals at no cost or avoiding them for fuel, revealing price-sensitive and briefing-dependent kill rates across models.

We present Dr. Claw, an open-source workspace that wraps existing coding-age

list.title: Knowing What Not to Answer: Selective Non-Compliance in Vision-Language Models

extra.desc: KoNA evaluates vision-language models on selective refusal across mixed queries and improves compliance via targeted fine-tuning.

list.title: Refuse without Refusal: A Structural Analysis of Safety-Tuning Responses for Reducing False Refusals in Language Models

extra.desc: Decomposing safety responses into refusal statements and rationales reveals that training on rationales alone reduces false refusals while preserving safety.

list.title: The 2026 PNPL Competition: Word Classification and Efficient Cross-Subject Generalisation in LibriBrain100

extra.desc: The 2026 PNPL competition introduces cross-subject and within-subject word classification tracks using an expanded MEG dataset to advance non-invasive speech-decoding brain-computer interfaces toward clinical feasibility.

list.title: UniMate: One Unified Model to Animate Diverse Skeletons

extra.desc: UniMate is a unified diffusion transformer that generates articulated motion for arbitrary skeletons from text and rigged 3D assets without per-skeleton retraining, using topology-aware attention and a large curated motion dataset.

list.title: One Editor, Many Edits: A Unified Training-Free Framework for Diverse Video Editing

extra.desc: EditVid is a unified training-free video editing framework that uses sparse causal memory, token injection, and soft latent blending to support both instruction-guided and subject-guided edits with high fidelity.

list.title: Beneath the Surface of Chains-of-Thought: A Mechanistic Interpretation of Reasoning Operations in LLMs

extra.desc: Distinct reasoning operations in language models are geometrically separable in hidden representations, with structure emerging across layers and depending on contextual reasoning context.

list.title: Training-Free Speech-Centric Omni Understanding with Frozen VLMs

extra.desc: TFO enables frozen vision-language models to perform speech-centric audio-visual understanding via modular transcript routing without retraining or architectural changes.

list.title: Bilevel Coordinated Reflection: A Game-Theoretic Approach to Multi-Agent LLM Systems

extra.desc: The study formalizes multi-agent LLM coordination via bilevel games and stochastic memory reflection, introducing a grounded evaluation gate and SRMA algorithm with convergence guarantees, validated on SWE-bench.

list.title: The Attention Triangle in Audio-Video Models

extra.desc: Audio-video diffusion models exhibit bidirectional semantic leakage through cross-modal attention pathways, which can be diagnosed via attention-derived signals and mitigated through inference-time alignment interventions.

list.title: To See a World in a Living Context: Unified Indoor-Outdoor Urban World Generation

extra.desc: HoloWorld unifies indoor and outdoor 3D urban generation through a continuously updated cross-scale context that ensures coherent building-level correspondence and cross-block continuity.

list.title: τ^τ-Bench: An Environment for End-To-End, Realistic Agent Construction

extra.desc: The τ^τ-bench benchmark evaluates coding agents on building real-world customer-service agents from business records, client requirements, and production APIs, revealing substantial gaps versus expert performance.

list.title: Enoki: Efficient Multi-Level Hallucination Detection

extra.desc: Enoki is an open information extraction framework that unifies claim-level verification and span-level hallucination localization through shared relational facts, reducing resource use while improving detection accuracy.

list.title: ShallowStream: Index Shallow then Answer Deep for Streaming Video Understanding

extra.desc: ShallowStream uses shallow MLLM layers to build a lightweight streaming index, reducing latency while maintaining accurate video retrieval.

list.title: AdaptVPR: Route-Aware Hard Positive Generation for Robust Visual Place Recognition

extra.desc: AdaptVPR improves visual place recognition by generating verified synthetic same-place images with diverse appearance changes to train more robust models.

list.title: Ask Before You Optimize: Dynamic Pre-Formulation Clarification for Interactive Optimization

extra.desc: OR-Clarify benchmarks clarification before optimization modeling, and InterOPT guides agents to ask questions or stop based on missing formulation-critical details.

list.title: Motion-Omni: End-to-End Joint Speech and Full-Body Motion for Spoken Dialogue

extra.desc: Motion-Omni is an end-to-end framework that jointly generates spoken dialogue and full-body co-speech motion from shared hidden states, using scalable pseudo-labeling and a unified evaluation protocol to achieve real-time, aligned responses.

list.title: When Models Edit Too Much: On the Fidelity of Minimal Code Edits

extra.desc: Large language models frequently over-edit code during repair, but preservation instructions and reinforcement learning can improve edit fidelity without sacrificing correctness.

list.title: MaxKernel: Agentic Kernel Generation for TPUs

extra.desc: MaxKernel is a multi-agent system that automates TPU kernel development through collaborative, autonomous, and graph-based search paradigms, achieving expert-level performance on diverse benchmarks.

list.title: RISE: Recursive Improvement via Self-Extrapolating Policy Distillation

extra.desc: RISE improves language model post-training by recursively generating dense token-level supervision from the model's own reinforcement learning trajectory via self-extrapolation, avoiding external teachers.

list.title: When Quantization Breaks Memory: Recurrent-State Write-Back in Low-Precision Temporal Inference

extra.desc: Quantized recurrent inference suffers from state write-back rules that suppress small updates, but error feedback and residual memory restore accuracy without retraining across GRU and LSTM architectures.

list.title: Don't Drop Dropout: Optimizing Layer Sparsity for Efficient LLM Training and Inference

extra.desc: Layer dropout improves large language model training efficiency and enables faster inference via early exit and speculative decoding without sacrificing accuracy.

list.title: WorldSculpt: Generating Compositional Worlds from Grounded Videos

extra.desc: Adapting a single-object 3D generative prior to multi-view observations enables scalable compositional mesh reconstruction of densely cluttered scenes with severe occlusion.

list.title: Group Adaptive Clipping Policy Optimization

extra.desc: GAPO adaptively adjusts importance-sampling clipping thresholds based on rollout advantage to preserve stronger gradient signals from low-success groups in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards.

list.title: Iris: Climbing to the Search Frontier

extra.desc: Two large-scale search agents are trained via a multi-stage pipeline combining supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning against live search, achieving state-of-the-art open-source results on complex web benchmarks through rigorous trajectory filtering and inference-time context management.

list.title: RoboTok: An Internet-Scale Data Engine for Human Demonstration Retrieval and Dexterous Manipulation Learning

extra.desc: RoboTok retrieves relevant human manipulation videos from the web using a latent motion space derived from 3D hand trajectories to improve robot policy training.

list.title: A Common Measure of Communication for Speech Brain-Computer Interfaces

extra.desc: Open-vocabulary mutual information provides a unified metric to compare speech brain-computer interfaces across different vocabularies and conditions, revealing trade-offs between vocabulary coverage and decoding accuracy.

list.title: VeriPhy: Agentic Physical Reasoning for World Model Evaluation and Refinement

extra.desc: VeriPhy verifies generated video by compiling prompts into typed physical obligations, executing frozen expert analyses with provenance tracking, and mapping evidence to auditable three-valued verdicts.

list.title: Locked at the Entrance, Open Inside: Where RLVR Narrows the Solution Space

extra.desc: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards narrows reasoning diversity primarily at the initial solution step rather than during execution, and targeted interventions can restore coverage without sacrificing accuracy.

list.title: DRACO: Fine-Grained Credit Assignment with Dynamic Rubrics for Long-Horizon Agent Training

extra.desc: DRACO dynamically generates rubrics and redistributes trajectory-level scores into per-step advantages for reinforcement learning without verifiers, improving long-horizon agent performance.

list.title: Last Translation Benchmark

extra.desc: The Last Translation Benchmark introduces peer-reviewed, multimodal examples that break leading translation models alongside handcrafted verification rules for reliable, actionable evaluation.

list.title: QCell: Recombining and Aligning Cell Queries for Overlapping Instance Segmentation

extra.desc: QCell is a query-based model that improves instance segmentation of overlapping microscopy cells through latent-space recombination and contrastive query alignment.

list.title: Select, Compress, Reinvest: A Controlled Study of Visual-Token Allocation in Long-Video MLLMs

extra.desc: Frame selection dominates accuracy in long-video language models, while spatial compression is nearly free if savings are reinvested into more frames, and a unified harness is needed to compare selectors fairly.

list.title: Using Grounded Theory for Agent Behavior Analysis at Scale

extra.desc: AutoTraceGT automates grounded theory coding on agent trajectories to build task-specific behavioral taxonomies that recover and extend human failure-mode annotations for downstream prediction.

list.title: Scal3R: Learning Efficient Multi-Relative Pose Query for Scalable Online 3D Reconstruction

extra.desc: Scal3R improves long-video online 3D reconstruction by querying multi-reference relative poses with lightweight tokens and pose-graph optimization, reducing drift without retraining the backbone.

list.title: Let Confidence Change, Not the Prediction: Prediction-Preserving Repair for Post-hoc Calibration

extra.desc: CORD is a post-fit adapter that repairs calibrated probability vectors to exactly preserve original top-1 predictions while maintaining calibration quality.

list.title: Compile by Training: Turning Natural-Language Specifications into Local Neural Functions

extra.desc: Compile by training converts natural-language specifications into reusable neural functions by distilling teacher-generated examples into small adapters, enabling efficient deployment without remote model dependencies.

list.title: Percolation Dynamics in Optimization : Variance Cascades and Discrete Scale Invariance

extra.desc: Stochastic gradient descent dynamics are modeled as a percolation process where architectural symmetries cause subnetworks to merge in discrete blocks, producing variance spikes resembling phase transitions, with similar trapping behavior extending to Adam and AdamW under heavy-tailed noise.

list.title: PACE: Towards Surfacing Hidden Conflicts in User Requests

extra.desc: PaceMaker uses coordinated agents to retrieve implicit contextual evidence and evaluate whether personalized requests conflict with hidden user constraints.

list.title: Knowing When Not to Reuse: Conditional Experience Transfer in Autonomous LLM Post-Training

extra.desc: Boundary-Calibrated Intervention Transfer selectively reuses past training evidence by checking contextual applicability and running bounded trials, reducing harmful updates and improving final model quality in autonomous post-training.

list.title: Puffin-World: Scaling a Unified Multimodal Model with Native 3D World States

extra.desc: Puffin-World is a unified multimodal framework that jointly models physics, geometry, and appearance for physically consistent 3D world generation, reconstruction, and closed-loop exploration.

list.title: Beyond Retrieval: Progressive Latent Memory Evolution for Streaming Video Understanding

extra.desc: LatentStream introduces a progressive latent working memory framework that internalizes streaming visual evidence into compact evolving tokens for continuous reasoning.

list.title: The Missing Temporal Link: Temporal Context Routing for Script-Driven Audio-Video Generation

extra.desc: Temporal Context Routing improves script-aligned timing of shots and dialogue in joint audio-video generation by mapping structured script timing onto shared video-audio temporal axes.

list.title: FlashRender: Few-Step Generative Rendering via Camera-Controlled Video MeanFlow

extra.desc: FlashRender accelerates generative video rendering via representation alignment, a mean-flow objective, and on-policy distillation to achieve high-quality few-step camera-controlled synthesis.

list.title: WorldReward: Reward Modeling for Camera-Conditioned World Models

extra.desc: WorldReward is a vision-language reward model that evaluates camera-conditioned world models by aligning video chunks with actions and aggregating preferences for both execution consistency and visual quality.
